assumptions.status: Full EDU-9B benefit scope and payroll-funded institution adopted by Espen; rates, phase-in, bridge grants, rebates and other fiscal reforms below are working recommendations, not adopted statutory parameters.

education.assumption_limits: 0.77T absorption is a pooled session estimate, not appropriation-level reconciliation. 12.5% tax offset and 20% protection reserve are authored allowances, not CBO/JCT scores. Post-2049 trends are stress-test extrapolations, not demographic forecasts. No additional dynamic revenue. A bridge grant is an expense of the GF, not free borrowing or dedicated receipts.

social_security.basis: Existing D8 plus SS-5; conservatively subtract 0.34 payroll points from 2031 for SS-2/SS-5 interaction, based on the model's SSA F10 versus F11+F8 comparison. Solve additional rate on existing capped OASDI base. No newly credited benefits for rate increase. Not a joint SSA score; H1a and GF tax interactions remain unscored.

adoption.status: Adopted by Espen: full EDU-9B benefit package and separate payroll-funded education institution. Exact rate, phasing, GF share, transition finance and household credit remain for decision.
scope: Universal school meals, CACFP and Summer EBT
EDU-4A pipeline, EDU-4B teacher salary floor through declining federal grants and state sustainability plans, EDU-4C paraprofessional and mental-health staffing, EDU-4D temporary bridge credit
adoption.source: sources/education-transforming-education-act-analysis-and-trust-fund.md, The trust fund model and Spending by component

cost_assumptions.outlay_basis: Education session aggregate nominal anchors; geometric interpolation. 2049 component sum is 441, aggregate 442: preserve source rounding, do not invent a component allocation.

fiscal_scenarios.name: Replace C19b/C20 plus housing/service space downside

funds.caveat: SS extra rate is capped-base, education uncapped. Joint income-tax offsets and cross-tax responses are not scored. These fund experiments are NOT summed into the education/unified fiscal scenarios.
